# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2009

**Cash Incentive for Barangay Chairperson Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance grants a cash incentive to barangay chairpersons in [[Pitogo, Quezon]] who have completed three consecutive terms of service. It defines the terms used in the ordinance, specifies the requirements for receiving the incentive, outlines the obligations of the local government unit, and appropriates funds for its implementation. The ordinance also includes provisions for implementing rules and regulations, separability, and repealing clause.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1. Title.** This ordinance shall be known and cited as the "Incentive Ordinance for Barangay Chairpersons."
2.  **Section 2. Definition of Terms.**
    *   "Local Government Unit" shall refer to the Local Government of the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon Province]].
    *   "Incentive" shall refer to the cash given to the Barangay chairpersons as incentive for their service.
    *   "Term" shall refer to the term of office of the elected official as mandated by law. This shall not include the term in which they were not elected as barangay chairperson such as in the case of succession to the duly elected barangay chairperson who resigned/terminated from office or other related circumstances.
    *   "Barangay Chairperson/s" shall refer to the chairpersons of the barangays in the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
3.  **Section 3.** All barangay chairperson who have successfully completed three consecutive terms of service shall receive from the Local Government Unit cash incentive amounting to six months of the prevailing monthly honorarium which they are receiving from their barangay.
4.  **Section 4.** The [[Pambayang Pederasyon ng Liga ng mga Barangay]] (PPLB), thru a resolution, shall certify and recommend to the Municipal Mayor the barangay chairpersons who have completed the required terms of service for the granting of incentive.
5.  **Section 5.** Only those barangay chairpersons who have been duly cleared by the Municipal Treasurer and the barangay Treasurers of any financial obligation to the local government and the barangay shall be eligible to receive the incentive.
6.  **Section 6. Obligation of the Local Government Unit.** It shall be the obligation of the local government unit to release the cash incentive within one (1) year after the expiration of the last term of the barangay chairperson subject to the usual budgeting, accounting and auditing requirements.
7.  **Section 7. Fund Appropriation.** Fund for the implementation of this ordinance shall be included in the annual budget of the local government unit during the year of release of the incentive.
8.  **Section 8. Implementing Rules and Regulations.** The Municipal Mayor, upon consultation with the [[Pambayang Pederasyon ng Liga ng mga Barangay]], shall implementating rules and regulations necessary for the efficient and effective implementation of this ordinance.
9.  **Section 9. Separability Clause.** It is declared that the provisions of this ordinance are separable, and in the event that one or more of the provisions are declared illegal or unconstitutional by a competent court, the validity of other provisions shall not be affected, and shall continue to be in force and effect.
10. **Section 10. Repealing Clause.** All ordinances, executive orders, rules and regulations inconsistent or in conflict with the provisions of this ordinance are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
11. **Section 11. Effectivity.** This ordinance shall immediately take effect after having complied with the provisions of [[Sec-511-RA7160|Section 511]] of [[RA-7160|Republic Act 7160]] otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991.
